# Juniper Lantern visitor guide

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

The front desk opens 30 minutes before the first class. Visitors enter through the teal courtyard gate. The side stair is staff only. A guardian may watch a first trial from the marked bench; other classes are drop-off unless the teacher invites a guardian. The studio has a step-free courtyard entrance and an accessible toilet. Ask the office before arrival if a quiet waiting area is needed. Water bottles are welcome; food stays outside the dance rooms.
